verdict.rationale: First-party docs say admins can manage users "including permissions and sessions" and that users can "manage sessions as well as view history" in the account console, which covers both personas. Single sign-out and a token revocation endpoint support logout across all applications and revocation of individual tokens. missing for 10: an explicit device listing, documented per-session vs. sign-out-all-sessions revocation controls, in-depth session-management docs beyond marketing-level statements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
